takeaways: High Microsoft 365 usage and uptime say nothing about control; drifted permissions, orphaned workspaces, unlabeled content and unreviewed audit logs form a hidden tenant underneath.
Copilot does not create new permission problems but turns broad hidden access into broad discoverability, so tenant quality determines both AI risk and AI answer quality.
Leaders should track the permission sprawl index, time to control lag and compliance visibility gap, starting with a 14-day governance reality check.
hook: Your Microsoft 365 tenant can look perfectly healthy while permissions drift, workspaces lose their owners and sensitive files stay unlabeled. This episode is for CIOs, security and compliance leads and M365 architects preparing for Copilot. You will learn three metrics and a 14-day reality check that make the invisible tenant measurable before it becomes an audit or AI problem.
